summary: Kairos Pharma filed an 8-K to issue a press release summarizing first-half 2026 achievements and second-half milestones. The release announces a signed term sheet to acquire worldwide rights to CL-741, a Phase 1-ready c-MET inhibitor for NSCLC and gastric cancers, from Celyn Therapeutics (backed by OrbiMed and Torrey Pines). No specific price, stake, premium, or close date is provided. The board has not yet made a formal recommendation, and no financial advisor is named. The acquisition is still at the term sheet stage, so terms are non-binding. Watch for a definitive agreement and any shareholder vote or regulatory clearance.
